mapper.select: SELECT hos.id AS hospital_id, hos.description, hos.medical_category AS hospitalCategory, hs.day, hs.start_time, hs.end_time, hs.day_off, hos.features FROM t_hospital hos JOIN t_hospital_schedule hs ON hos.id = hs.hospital_id WHERE hos.id = #{hospitalId} AND hos.state = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY hs.id;
SELECT day, start_time, end_time, day_off FROM t_hospital_schedule WHERE hospital_id = #{hospitalId};

SELECT h.id, file.path AS thumb_nail, h.name, h.address, h.address_detail, h.city AS city, h.district AS district, h.phone_number FROM t_hospital h LEFT JOIN t_files file ON h.image_group_id = file.group_id WHERE h.id = #{hospitalId} AND file.file_order = 1 AND h.state = 'ACTIVE';
SELECT * FROM t_hospital WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' AND id = #{hospitalId} ORDER BY exposed_rank

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM t_article a WHERE a.review_type_id IN (SELECT e.id FROM t_event e WHERE e.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} AND e.state = 'ACTIVE' AND e.type = 'EVENT' ORDER BY e.date_created)
AND (
array_to_string(a.category, ',') LIKE '%' || #{item} || '%'
)
AND a.available_yn='Y' AND a.review_type = 'EVENT' ) AS subquery
